answer_1.quote: Experiments on various NLP tasks, including language inference benchmarks and Google Bigbench tasks, show that although the student model is trained on the general data that is irrelevant to the downstream tasks, it can inherit teacher model abilities, leading to excellent downstream performances better than or comparable to those of larger models.
answer_1.outputs: The student model generates answers to downstream tasks such as natural language inference, paraphrasing, Boolean QA, sentiment analysis, and multiple-choice QA in BIG-bench.

answer_2.quote: The results are evaluated by the accuracy of the predicted answers.
